versions.content: Handling if EthSwt_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called with Active is set to TRUE , the secured association is activated and EthSwtPort- MacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthSwtPort identified with the given SwitchPortIdx at the EthSwtConfig identified with the given SwitchIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to TRUE • the transmission secured association given with An exists and has already been activated then the EthSwt driver shall update the transmission secure association given with An at the Ethernet switch port that corresponds to the given SwitchPortIdx at the Eth- ernet switch that corresponds to the given SwitchIdx by considering the next packet number (see NextPn ) and return with E_OK . Otherwise, if the addressed transmission secured association given with An does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK
